verdict.rationale: Elastic documents first-party background automation: alerting rules evaluate continuously and send notifications, synthetic monitoring proactively runs user journeys and API checks, and the 'nightshift AI SRE' is described as detecting and investigating incidents on its own. The evidence is marketing-level, though, and does not show how a user configures, schedules or scopes autonomous agentic automations. Missing for 10: documentation on setting up and scheduling autonomous AI automations, details on what actions automations can take beyond alerting and investigation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
You can create a rule to send an alert when the log aggregation exceeds a threshold.
You can also extend your alerts with notifications via services or third-party incident management systems.
Proactively simulate user journeys and API calls to test application availability and functionality.
